meta.name: product-launch-video
meta.description: Turn a product or marketing URL, pasted script, or brief into a product launch / promo video — SaaS promos, feature reveals, product demos, app and company launches. Use when the user wants to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product; the default for any commercial URL. Site tours / showcases of a website route here too — the brief carries the show-it-as-is intent. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把产品链接或简报变成宣传视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正需要为产品发布制作宣传视频
copy.tagline_en: Turn a product link or brief into a promo video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're launching a product and need a promo video

howto.what: 装好后,面对产品宣传/发布需求,Claude 会把产品网页、粘贴的脚本或简介做成一支宣传视频:它按步骤建项目、抓取素材、定视觉风格、写分镜与旁白、逐帧生成画面,最后渲染出 MP4 成品。
howto.when: 当你想宣传、发布或展示某产品,给出产品/营销网址,或想做网站导览/宣传视频时触发;意图不明时转 /hyperframes 总流程。

say.text: 这段产品介绍给你,请按原文口吻写成旁白并排好分镜,做成演示视频
say.note: 无网页素材时也能用;Claude 按文字 brief 做片。

say.text: 这是我们的官网首页,请做一支站点导览短片,画面按页面原样呈现
say.note: 适合展示网站本身;以真实截图为视觉底稿。

howto.what_en: Claude turns a product/marketing URL, pasted script, or brief into a promo/launch video: sets up a project, captures assets, fixes design style, writes storyboard & narration, builds scene frames, renders MP4.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user wants to market/launch/promote/reveal a product, provides a marketing URL, or asks for a website tour/showcase; unclear intent routes to /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Make this SaaS page https://example.com into a 30-second launch promo.
say_en.note: Claude captures the page and runs the pipeline.

say_en.text: Here is my product brief — turn it into a demo video, reading it as voiceover.
say_en.note: Text-only route; Claude works from the brief.

say_en.text: This is our homepage; make a site-tour clip showing it as-is.
say_en.note: Useful for showcasing the site itself.
